evals.prompt: Brief on SIREN 552100554 as of 2020-06-30 before I contact them.
evals.expected_output: Brief for PEUGEOT SA, active on 2020-06-30, with BODACC events dated on or before 2020-06-30 only.
expectations: Identity is confirmed from the SIREN
The company is reported active on 2020-06-30
No signal is dated after 2020-06-30
Every Fact row has a reference link
The retrieval log lists recherche-entreprises, bodacc, boamp, decp, ted, cordis, ademe, ratios-inpi, rss, web-search and crm when a CRM company is in scope
Managers, if listed, have no birth date

evals.expected_output: PEUGEOT SA is closed since 2021-01-16; verdict Do not pursue.
expectations: The closure date 2021-01-16 is stated
The verdict is Do not pursue
The BODACC radiation notice is in the signals with its link

evals.prompt: Fais-moi un brief sur Dupont avant que je les appelle.
evals.expected_output: Several candidates listed in French; no brief written.
expectations: The answer is in French
Up to 5 candidates are listed with SIREN, city, NAF and state
The user is asked to choose
No qualification verdict is given

evals.expected_output: The company did not exist yet on that date (created 1955-01-01).
expectations: The creation date is compared with the as-of date
The brief stops with that finding
No qualification verdict is given

evals.prompt: Brief on SIREN 110000445 as of 2020-12-31, including public contracts.
evals.expected_output: BOAMP notices are labelled by role; notices where the SIREN is the buyer are not counted as won contracts.
expectations: Each BOAMP notice has a role: buyer, winner or unclear
No notice where the company is the buyer is counted as a won contract
Each BOAMP notice has its url_avis link

evals.prompt: Brief on SIREN 552100554 as of 2019-01-01, with press coverage.
evals.expected_output: RSS feeds are logged not applicable for a 2019 date; press comes from web search, labelled Interpretation.
expectations: RSS is logged not applicable, not as no news
Press items are labelled Interpretation
No press item is dated after 2019-01-01

evals.prompt: Write the brief on SIREN 552100554 as of 2020-06-30 to its Notion Company page.
evals.expected_output: Preview first, wait for go; brief goes to the page body; properties are not overwritten with older years.
expectations: A preview is shown before any Notion write
No Notion write happens without an explicit go
The previous brief is replaced, not followed by an addendum
No property is overwritten with an older year
A missing property is proposed, not created without validation

evals.prompt: Brief on SIREN 908713043 for my active ICP profile, then write it to the Notion Company page.
evals.expected_output: Short Notion body: hook first, dated interest signals with links, ICP score table, at most 5 checks; identity in properties.
expectations: The Notion body starts with a hook that names concrete recent signals
Each signal line has a date, a type and a source link
The qualification table has the columns ICP criterion, Score, Comment
The qualification heading links the ICP page
The body has no Identity, Timeline, Claims, Retrieval log or Conflicts section
The body has at most 25 top-level blocks
NAF, head office, manager and registry link are proposed as properties, not written in the body

evals.expected_output: Brief that reads the collective procedure as a running plan, with the verdict Hold.
expectations: The procedure state is a running sauvegarde or continuation plan, from the judgment dated 2025-03-21
The two BODACC notices of the same 2025-03-21 judgment appear as one signal row
The event date of the procedure signal is the judgment date, not the publication date
The verdict is Hold, and the hook makes no positive claim

evals.expected_output: Brief in which the BODACC notice annulled on 2025-01-26 is not used.
expectations: The BODACC notice published on 2023-10-31 and annulled on 2025-01-26 is not reported as a Fact
The annulment is named in Conflicts and stale data or in the retrieval log
No signal or hook relies on the annulled notice

evals.prompt: Brief on SIREN 542107651 as of 2024-11-01, including public contracts.
evals.expected_output: Brief that computes contract end dates from DECP and flags the renewals due.
expectations: At least one DECP contract end date is computed as datenotification + dureemois
A contract notified on 2023-01-17 for 24 months is reported as a contract renewal due around 2025-01-17
Every signal row has a Strength value from 0 to 5
Exactly one signal is marked as the hook, and it is inside its hook window

evals.prompt: Which public contracts did SIREN 542107651 win in 2024? Use BOAMP.
evals.expected_output: Wins found by name in BOAMP award notices, labelled Interpretation unless DECP or the postcode confirms them.
expectations: BOAMP is also searched by the company name in titulaire, not only by SIREN
A notice where the SIREN appears only as the buyer is never counted as a contract won
A win found only by name is labelled Interpretation, or Fact with the confirming DECP record or postcode
